messages:
elaine_sales: AcmeBio wants to run a POC with a custom RootNet-14b variant. Need quick preflight: can we serve a quantized 14B variant from our catalog? Also need tokenizer parity, BYOK (KMS) support, and a rough hosted vs dedicated price for ~100k tok/day. Any immediate blockers? (cc @sam_eng @nina_security) :wave:
sam_eng: Short answer: probably yes. Need to confirm model internals: RoPE vs ALiBi, RMSNorm vs LayerNorm, any flash-attention-incompatible ops. Also: who owns the weights/license?
elaine_sales: Customer says weights are Apache-2, HF repo: https://huggingface.co/acme/rootnet-14b. They plan to use a custom vocab/tokenizer. They also want KV-cache enabled for conversational flows.
mike_infra: KV cache is fine. Quant path: we support int8/int4 inference via our quant pipeline but 14B hits memory pressure — Dedicated is recommended for predictable latency SLOs. I'll draft cost numbers. Any preference for conversion format (ggml, q4_0)?
nina_security: KMS note: BYOK is supported in Dedicated/Private. Hosted offers envelope encryption with our KMS (no customer-managed keys currently). Also need to confirm data classification — is any PHI involved? We'll need a sec questionnaire if so.
elaine_sales: They say no PHI, just aggregated clinical research summaries (non-identifiable). They insist on BYOK. I'll tell them Dedicated or Private is required then.
sam_eng: Two technical asks for the POC: (1) tokenizer parity — we ingest their tokenizer and run normalization/tokenization tests; (2) layer/ops compatibility check. Can we get a small artifact (config.json + tokenizer files + one shard) so we can smoke-test? We can run: `python infra/tools/check_model.py --model-path ./artifact`
opsbot: deploy-bot: quick-smoke pipeline queued (#14239). Will post logs to /eng-runtime/deploys/14239 when finished.
mike_infra: Pricing draft: hosted (burstable): ~ $120/day for 100k tok/day (best-effort latency). Dedicated (reserved capacity with SLA): ~$7.2k/month for steady throughput and BYOK. Quant conversion service is a one-time $X engineering fee (we can quote). I'll refine numbers after smoke.
elaine_sales: Action items: (1) Nina — confirm BYOK + required attestation doc for Dedicated vs Private so I can share with Acme. (2) Sam/Mike — run tokenizer smoke, report token mismatch <=1% target; confirm conversion route (q8/q4) and estimated engineering time. I'll capture these in the POC SOW. :memo:
nina_security: Confirmed: BYOK available for Dedicated/Private only. Hosted uses our KMS/envelope. I'll attach the attestation checklist and minimum compliance controls needed for BYOK flow.
sam_eng: Started tokenizer smoke on sample corpus — token mismatch ~0.6% so far, looks acceptable. No flash-attention or fused-op incompat observed in the smoke run. Posting logs to deploy job shortly.
elaine_sales: Perfect — I'll share that with the customer and schedule kickoff for next Tue. Thanks team :thumbsup:
